headline: Application worker cannot access staging bucket

findings.evidence_ref: The IAM policy grants S3 access only to arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data and arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data/*, but the PR creates a new bucket acme-prod-tmp-uploads. The app_data_bucket_arns variable in variables.tf is not updated to include the staging bucket ARNs.
findings.explanation: The PR description states that 'uploads land here, the worker validates and moves them' — but the worker running with the app role has no permissions to read from or write to the staging bucket (acme-prod-tmp-uploads). This will cause the validation and move operation to fail with permission errors. The app_data_bucket_arns variable needs to include the staging bucket ARNs: arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-tmp-uploads and arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-tmp-uploads/*
